original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-fully-faithful}
Let $I \subset \mathfrak a$ be ideals of a Noetherian ring $A$.
Let $U = \Spec(A) \setminus V(\mathfrak a)$. Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $A$ is $I$-adically complete and has a dualizing complex,
\item for any associated prime $\mathfrak p \subset A$ with
$\mathfrak p \not \in V(I)$ and
$V(\mathfrak p) \cap V(I) \not \subset V(\mathfrak a)$ and
$\mathfrak q \in V(\mathfrak p) \cap V(\mathfrak a)$ we have
$\dim((A/\mathfrak p)_\mathfrak q) > \text{cd}(A, I) + 1$,
\item for $\mathfrak p \subset A$ with $\mathfrak p \not \in V(I)$
and $V(\mathfrak p) \cap V(I) \subset V(\mathfrak a)$
we have $\text{depth}(A_\mathfrak p) \geq 2$.
\end{enumerate}
Then the completion functor
$$
\textit{Coh}(\mathcal{O}_U)
\longrightarrow
\textit{Coh}(U, I\mathcal{O}_U),
\quad
\mathcal{F} \longmapsto \mathcal{F}^\wedge
$$
is fully faithful on the full subcategory of
finite locally free objects.
hold_reason: The pinned lemma at lines 4747–4772 gives full faithfulness of Coh(O_U)→Coh(U,I O_U) only on finite locally free objects under the exact completion, associated-prime dimension and depth hypotheses. Stage B prepends to its hypotheses an unrelated neighborhood colimit category indexed by an undefined V, and the editorial statement 'No conclusion ... is upgraded to essential surjectivity'. The extra unbound, non-hypothesis assertions prevent approval of the exact materialization, despite its correct core lemma.
proposed_correction: Remove the entire unsolicited prefatory paragraph from both statement and hypotheses; use the pinned original lemma with the three numbered premises and the fully faithful-on-finite-locally-free conclusion. Route corrected fields through a new independent source-first review.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-fully-faithful-general}
Let $I \subset \mathfrak a \subset A$ be ideals of a Noetherian ring $A$.
Let $U = \Spec(A) \setminus V(\mathfrak a)$. Let $\mathcal{V}$ be
the set of open subschemes of $U$ containing $U \cap V(I)$
ordered by reverse inclusion. Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $A$ is $I$-adically complete and has a dualizing complex,
\item for any associated prime
$\mathfrak p \subset A$ with
$I \not \subset \mathfrak p$ and
$V(\mathfrak p) \cap V(I) \not \subset V(\mathfrak a)$
and $\mathfrak q \in V(\mathfrak p) \cap V(\mathfrak a)$ we have
$\dim((A/\mathfrak p)_\mathfrak q) > \text{cd}(A, I) + 1$.
\end{enumerate}
Then the completion functor
$$
\colim_\mathcal{V} \textit{Coh}(\mathcal{O}_V)
\longrightarrow
\textit{Coh}(U, I\mathcal{O}_U),
\quad
\mathcal{F} \longmapsto \mathcal{F}^\wedge
$$
is fully faithful on the full subcategory of
finite locally free objects.

But the exact prepared hypotheses also contain a separate generic category tutorial and an editorial claim about what the lemma does NOT conclude, rather than just the theorem's predicates. The extra metacommentary is not a hypothesis and needs removal before exact-content registration.
